source: Traced from the Copernicus 90 m DEM (flow directions); areas are approximate (about ±10-15% on flat floodplain country)

catchments.name: Condamine River total (to Chinchilla)
catchments.note: the whole river down to Chinchilla Weir: Killarney, Warwick, Toowoomba, Dalby, Warra and Jandowae country, all its creeks included

catchments.name: Wilkie Creek
catchments.note: to its junction with the Condamine north-west of Dalby

catchments.name: Myall Creek
catchments.note: through Dalby, to its junction with the Condamine west of Dalby

catchments.name: Hodgson Creek
catchments.note: from the range south of Toowoomba (Hodgson Vale), past Cambooya, Greenmount and Southbrook, to the Condamine west of Brookstead

catchments.name: Jimbour Creek
catchments.note: through Jimbour and Macalister, to its junction with the Condamine

catchments.name: Condamine River above Tummaville
catchments.note: the top of the river: Killarney, the Main Range, Warwick, Allora, Clifton and Leyburn country, down to the Tummaville gauge

catchments.name: Condamine River, Tummaville to Dalby
catchments.note: the river's own country between Tummaville and Dalby (Brookstead, Cecil Plains, Pittsworth, Millmerran side), including Hodgson Creek and the North Branch; not the country above Tummaville

catchments.name: Condamine River, Dalby to Chinchilla Weir
catchments.note: the river's own country below Dalby to Chinchilla Weir, including Myall, Wilkie, Jimbour and Jandowae creeks; not the country above Dalby

catchments.name: Jandowae Creek
catchments.note: from the Bunya Mountains side past Cooranga and Jandowae, to the Condamine near Brigalow (downstream of Warra)

catchments.name: Jinghi Jinghi (Jingi Jingi) Creek
catchments.note: from north of Jandowae past the Jinghi Jinghi gauge, west to Charleys Creek north-east of Chinchilla

catchments.name: Charleys Creek
catchments.note: from the Durong and Burra Burri country through Chinchilla, to the Condamine below Chinchilla Weir

catchments.name: Brisbane River above Wivenhoe Dam (incl. Stanley)
catchments.note: the upper Brisbane River, from the Blackbutt Range and Brisbane Valley (Esk, Toogoolawah), with the Stanley River and Somerset Dam, to Wivenhoe Dam

catchments.name: Stanley River above Somerset Dam
catchments.note: from the Conondale and D'Aguilar ranges (Peachester, Woodford, Kilcoy side) to Somerset Dam

catchments.name: Lockyer Creek
catchments.note: from the range below Toowoomba (Murphys Creek, Helidon, Gatton, Laidley, Forest Hill) to the Brisbane River below Wivenhoe Dam

catchments.name: Brisbane River total (to Mt Crosby)
catchments.note: the whole Brisbane River above Mt Crosby: Wivenhoe and Somerset catchments, the Lockyer Valley and the country down past Fernvale (not the Bremer, which joins below)

catchments.name: Bremer River (to Ipswich)
catchments.note: from the Little Liverpool and Main ranges (Rosewood, Grandchester, Boonah side, Warrill and Purga creeks) through Ipswich to the Brisbane River

catchments.name: Logan River (above the Albert)
catchments.note: from the McPherson and Main ranges (Rathdowney, Beaudesert, Jimboomba, Logan Village) to Waterford

catchments.name: Albert River
catchments.note: from Lamington and the McPherson Range past Canungra side, Tamborine and Wolffdene to the Logan near Eagleby

catchments.name: Pine Rivers (North and South Pine)
catchments.note: from the D'Aguilar Range (Mt Glorious, Samford, Dayboro, Lake Samsonvale) to Bramble Bay

catchments.name: Caboolture River
catchments.note: from the D'Aguilar Range near Wamuran through Caboolture to Deception Bay

catchments.name: Mary River above Gympie
catchments.note: from the Conondale Range and Blackall Range (Maleny, Kenilworth, Conondale, Imbil, Kandanga) to Gympie

catchments.name: Maroochy River
catchments.note: from the Blackall Range (Mapleton, Eumundi, Yandina, Nambour) to the coast at Maroochydore

catchments.name: North Branch Condamine (incl. Oakey Creek)
catchments.note: local catchment, from Oakey and Jondaryan to where it rejoins the Condamine south-west of Dalby; in big floods it also carries water spilt from the main river
